lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2ZnSe4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms—Nd8Zn4Se16—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Nd centers with a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement of eight Se neighbors, while Zn adopts a tetrahedral environment of four Se neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Nd 8-vertex and Zn 4-vertex polyhedra and corner- and face-sharing among Nd polyhedra.
